property_summary: The reference P always returns the correct controller address stored during initialization; the buggy M hardcodes an incorrect address, so calling controller() after initialization returns the wrong address.
change_summary: Hardcode a burn address (0x0000...0001), so controller() returns a different address.
mutated_unit_code: function controller() public view returns (IController) { return IController(address(0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001)); }
